description: This file defines a lock-free single-producer single-consumer (SPSC) queue template class, including memory management, synchronization, and queue operations.

classes.name: rigtorp::SPSCQueue
classes.description: A lock-free, single-producer single-consumer queue template class with configurable allocator, supporting emplace, push, try_emplace, try_push, front, pop, size, empty, and capacity operations.

methods.name: SPSCQueue
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the queue with a specified capacity and optional allocator, managing memory allocation and alignment.

methods.name: ~SPSCQueue
methods.description: Destructor that deallocates memory and cleans up remaining elements.

methods.name: emplace
methods.description: Constructs an element in-place at the tail of the queue with perfect forwarding of arguments.

methods.name: try_emplace
methods.description: Attempts to construct an element in-place; returns false if the queue is full.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Copies or moves a value into the queue.

methods.name: try_push
methods.description: Attempts to push a value into the queue; returns false if full.

methods.name: front
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the front element if available, nullptr otherwise.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Removes the front element from the queue.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the current number of elements in the queue.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the queue is empty.

methods.name: capacity
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of elements the queue can hold.
